summary: Divider is a semantic horizontal or vertical separator, optionally with a centered label. Spacer is presentational empty space.
whenToUse: Spacer to push items to the ends of a flex row.
whenNotToUse: To create space between elements: prefer the gap of Stack/Inline/Grid.

props.name: Spacer.size
props.description: Fixed size; without it, the Spacer fills the available space in a flex container.

inherits: Divider: react-aria-components Separator props. Spacer: HTML attributes of <span>.
accessibility: Divider exposes role="separator"; Spacer is aria-hidden.
The Divider label is regular text, read by screen readers.
responsive: The vertical Divider stretches to the height of the flex row.
commonMistakes: Using many Dividers where more white space would suffice.
